statement: The A100982 transform attributed to Lombardo (18 October 2019), as printed in the OEIS export of 20 September 2026, has upper limit A020914(n-1)-n-2 and fails already at n=2: the sum is empty, giving 0, whereas the unique OOEE certificate gives A100982(2)=1. This refutes the displayed formula, not the counting sequence or Paper B's independent dynamic program.

Using exact integer A325913 boundary indices and the A325904 recurrence, replacing the printed A100982 upper limit by A020914(n-1)-n reproduces every minimal-certificate count at orders 1..256 and every survivor count at depths 0..406 after reinserting the length-one certificate. Independent inversion from the prefix DP recovers more than 50 generator coefficients. The dated A325904 stored terms first disagree with their recurrence at index 21 (-517564939540551 versus -517564939540550), with further disagreements through stored index 26. Using those stored coefficients makes even the repaired transform fail at order 37 by one. Finite agreement is not an all-orders proof, an asymptotic estimate, or a termination result.
